page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. System memory totals 256.0 GB, yielding a balanced memory density of 4.0 GB per vCPU core.

This server instance does not include integrated local disk storage and contains zero GPUs. Storage operations depend entirely on network-attached volumes. Networking functionality includes a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers balanced resource distribution for non-specialized compute loads. The absence of local disk drives requires reliance on remote storage, trading local disk latency for cloud storage flexibility. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.16xlarge is suited for enterprise web application clusters, backend microservices, general-purpose databases, and CI/CD automation pipelines.
